Author: kihtli
Name: Relic Atlas
Description: In-game relic progression for 150 weapon and tool tracks, from Zodiac to Phantom and Mastercraft to Cosmic. Covers all 11 crafting/gathering classes, Skysteel, Resplendent, Splendorous and Cosmic tools through Tools of Stars. Overview shows every eligible job and expansion, completion totals and next stages. Open a relic's checklist, track objectives and materials, and keep separate character profiles. Automatic detection plus manual corrections. Open with /relicatlas. Shopping list compares carried stock with optional Allagan Tools storage. /relicatlas atma shows an experimental ST farming schedule with optional Teleporter travel; automatic travel is opt-in for each session.
Punchline: Relic weapons and tools, every job, every next step.

Author: kihtli
Name: Outfit Studio
Punchline: Testing prerelease: refit Penumbra outfits between compatible body meshes.
Description: Choose a source body, an outfit and one or more destination bodies to create a new mod with their body and size choices. Automatically matches labelled source sizes, keeps other outfit styles and previews the combined options. Advanced manual references remain available for one destination body. Processing runs in a separate worker. Open with /outfitstudio. Experimental: review converted outfits in game.
